title: The CFPB Consumer Response Portal With AI Complaint Handling: The 15-Day and 60-Day Response Windows, the Portal Tag Discipline, and the Public-Database Read the Bank Cannot Ignore
summary: Every complaint routed through the CFPB Consumer Response portal is a supervised, time-boxed compliance event with a 15-day acknowledgment, a 60-day substantive response, a specific issue-and-sub-issue taxonomy that becomes the public database, and a consumer-dispute flag the Bureau tracks. The rule reads simple and the operations misfire often. Where the AI agent tightens the intake, the response drafting, and the root-cause loop, and the audit file the Bureau tests against in an examination.
